headline: Michael J. Fox Honored with Canada's Highest Order
meta_description: Michael J. Fox receives the highest order of Canada honor for his decades of advocacy work on Parkinson's disease.
summary_short: Michael J. Fox has been recognized with Canada's highest order for his sustained advocacy in the fight against Parkinson's disease.
body:
Michael J. Fox has received the highest order of Canada honor, a recognition of his tireless advocacy work on Parkinson's disease.

The award marks a milestone in Fox's public health journey. Since going public with his diagnosis years ago, the actor has become one of the most visible voices in raising awareness and funding research for the neurological condition that affects millions worldwide.

Fox's commitment extends beyond personal resilience—his foundation and public platform have helped reshape how society discusses living with Parkinson's. The honor reflects not only his celebrity status but the genuine impact his advocacy has had on patients, families, and the broader medical community. For many, Fox's openness has transformed Parkinson's from a condition spoken about in whispers into a subject worthy of sustained public conversation and research investment.

Award celebrates decades of public health work
